quotes.name: Bill
quotes.role: Web developer, joined on a T Level placement in September 2025
quotes.text: I thought the placement would be a basic storefront. A few product pages, prices on, done. Instead I was given creative freedom. Told what the business needed, then trusted to work out how it should look and work. It turned into a proper, highly designed website. I'm grateful for that. Not many places would hand that much responsibility to someone on a placement, and when I got things wrong, they showed me why and let me fix it. Real work, real trust, and people kind enough to expect me to get good at it.

roles_created.route: T Level and college placements, Job Centre
